name: XDL Monocular Rangefinder
description: The highly accurate XDL Monocular Rangefinder from Behring is as suitable on an expedition as it is on the battlefield. Ruggedly constructed with high-quality lenses, easy-to-read display, and a light-amplification mode, the XDL provides 10x magnification to reliably provide exact-distance laser measurements on faraway targets.
